name: Rootwater merfolk
description: Merfolk transported to Rath who descended into savage lives under Skyshroud.

description_citations.text: "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves' and merfolk's floating home is transported to Rath; they fight, and the elves create Skyshroud while the merfolk are driven into the swamp below.
timeline.quote: the elves and merfolk began to run out of resources and eventually faced each other in armed conflict

citation.text: "Rath", section "The Elves of Skyshroud and The Rootwater Merfolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise creates a ward keeping the Skyshroud warm so the rootwater merfolk survive on Keld.
timeline.quote: were it not for the intervention of Freyalise , who created a magical ward in the forest to keep it warm
